nodes.label: v3/README.md
Goal: run the chosen HERB questions through three arms (artifact / lucene / vector), get an answer from each, and score those answers with RAGAS

All three arms answer with the same generator, built once in the orchestrator and injected, so any difference is retrieval not the LLM; beyond that generator and the corpus on disk the arms share nothing, each reading, indexing and ranking the corpus with its own code
artifact arm = the artefact graph (interpreter -> facet retrieval -> answer), the system under test, built natively in v3
lucene arm = BM25 baseline with its own index over the corpus
vector arm = dense / naive-RAG baseline with its own index over the corpus
RAGAS (eval/ragas.py) is the scorer; the full metric menu lives in eval/ragas_catalog.py; every judge-free deterministic metric always runs because it costs nothing, and SELECTED adds the judged ones
Deterministic backbone = ID-based context precision/recall against the gold citations (IDBasedContextPrecision / IDBasedContextRecall, no judge)

Judged picks = faithfulness, answer correctness, and context recall; context_precision_llm_ref stays commented out because it is ~k judge calls per question; faithfulness needs no reference so transfers to a no-gold set, the other judged metrics lean on the gold answer / citations
RAGAS emits raw per-question records (EvalResult, tidy long format) with nothing pre-aggregated, so paired tests, CIs, per-type splits and judge calibration are all possible downstream

Each run writes a RunManifest (arm, generator model, top-k, questions file, n, timestamp, build stats) and an EvalManifest (scorer, judge model, backend, reasoning effort, aggregate judge usage including reasoning tokens, source run, arm, timestamp) for reproducibility

GPT judge runs use the signed-in Codex CLI (not OPENAI_API_KEY) and Gemini judge runs use the signed-in Gemini CLI (not an API key), the same subscription-authenticated pattern as the Claude judge; their manifests carry provider-reported input, cached-input, output and reasoning-token usage, aggregate request time, and eval wall time

Data split (the quarantine): data/corpus/ has the oracle stripped out and pipelines see only this via a truth-free prompt; data/raw/ is full HERB with the ~1514 questions + ground_truth + citations, read in place by evaluators only; metadata/ (employee / customer / team directories) stays on both sides as legitimate retrieval data
Generation and scoring are split into two separate phases so iterating a scorer never re-runs the LLM; three modes: questions, evals, and full (the two back to back)

questions mode: one arm answers the chosen questions and writes a per-run folder with records.jsonl (one oracle-free row per question) + run_manifest.json; rows append as they go so a crash keeps what finished, a hard error fails loud and stops
evals mode: one scorer reads a run folder, re-joins truth (type, ground_truth, citations) by id from data/questions.jsonl, and writes eval_results.jsonl + eval_manifest.json
Decided: RAGAS is the only scorer; three arms, one shared generator, and a top-k budget shared across arms (that it is shared is decided, the value itself is still open)

Decided: shared generator is qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b on NVIDIA NIM injected into all three arms; the judge defaults to haiku (claude-haiku-4-5) through the headless Claude CLI, and --judge can swap in another Claude, GPT-5.4 mini, or Gemini model; not GPT-4o, so HERB's published baselines get re-run not cited

Decided generation contract, a thin fixed RAG pipe: one fixed system instruction 'Answer the question using only the provided documents. Be concise.', then the question exactly as posed plus the arm's retrieved passages as a labelled user turn, returning a structured {answer}; held byte-identical across all three arms so the only variable remains the retrieval

Decided lucene arm built with bm25s method='lucene' (the Lucene / Elasticsearch BM25 variant, k1=0.9 / b=0.4 are the BEIR reference values); one document per artifact, artifacts-only index; all 17,087 gold citations resolve to an artifact id so context_ids share the citation id space

Decided vector arm built with embedder nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 on NIM (multilingual incl. Swedish, English-strong, 8192-token context); one document per artifact embedded whole (longest HERB artifact ~1.5k tokens, no truncation and no chunking); exact brute-force cosine with no ANN (the ~38.6k-artifact corpus is too small to need one); a capable multilingual dense baseline, NOT the English-only 256-token all-MiniLM textbook naive-RAG default
Question ids minted deterministically <product>::a|u::<index> from (product file, array, position): 815 answerable + 699 unanswerable = 1514, unique, the paired-test join key

build_question_sets writes the {id, type, question} id-set views full / answerable / unanswerable (1514 / 815 / 699) plus question_ids.gold100.jsonl, the gold-100, a balanced answerable subset drawn by seeded round-robin over the HERB types (equal allocation, ~20/type); report per-type and do not compare the gold-100 aggregate to HERB's published average

Still open: the orchestrator split into the questions / evals / full modes with per-run-folder run identity; the top-k budget value; which set to run (gold-100 vs the full 815 + 699); the judge calibration subset size

Caveat: answer-level scoring measures the whole pipeline not retrieval alone, since a strong generator can mask retrieval quality; the deterministic context precision/recall is what keeps an endpoint pointed directly at retrieval, which is the artefact's actual claim
